name: pair
description: Pair or a team across Claude Code tabs — one driver does the task, integrates and reports; a navigator (pair) or one or more architects and one or more testers (team) review the plan before any work, approve the gated items, review the rest asynchronously and verify the result themselves. Each architect picks the profiles it weighs especially (code quality, the project's own architecture, a solution proportionate to the task); role names carry suffixes like pair-architect-[project] or pair-tester-[e2e]; every verdict is recorded against one member, item, revision and snapshot, so one reviewer's OK is not everybody's. Free conversation, a seven-type protocol, review requests with revisions and quoted evidence, a shared state file, all over cross-session messages in the same working directory
